description: Base template for ThreatConnect TCV applications
name: TCV App Template

notes: Added a Settings page and a first-run onboarding stepper.
Non-connection inputs are now configured in the Settings UI rather than at deployment. Set feedDeployer/serviceConfig to false for those params in app_spec.yml.

Not a breaking change for existing deployments: previously configured input values still flow into app_inputs and are seeded into the stored settings record on first boot, and an app with prior job history has onboarding auto-completed so it keeps ingesting without an admin running the stepper.
Added notification support to TIE apps (min server version 7.12.2)
